cluster.title: Your wallet may be on the wrong network
cluster.body: This sale settles on devnet. A wallet set to mainnet cannot simulate or sign it.
cluster.step2: Phantom: Settings, Developer Settings, turn on Testnet Mode, then choose Solana Devnet. Solflare and Backpack: switch the network to Devnet in settings.
cluster.step3: Come back here and try again.

verify.title: Verify the bids
verify.lede: Every bid is signed. This page rebuilds the proof (a hash of the bids) from the public bids in your browser. If the lot has been paid, it then reads the payment from the Solana network and compares the proof it finds there with your own result.
verify.unavailable: The verification data is not available for this lot yet.

check.mismatch: Signed text does not match this bid

verify.onchain: Memo in the payment transaction, read from the network

state.checking: Reading the payment from the network…
state.confirmed: Confirmed. The proof stored in the finalized payment transaction matches these bids.

contradicts.hash: Does not match. The proof in the payment transaction differs from the proof computed from these bids. Both values are listed above.
contradicts.settlement: Does not match. The memo in the transaction names another settlement ({found}) than the one this lot belongs to ({expected}).
contradicts.memo: Not confirmed. The transaction has no valid Hammerprice memo (exactly one memo that starts with hp:settle: is required), so it carries no proof of these bids.
contradicts.failed: Not confirmed. The transaction failed on the network, so it did not settle this lot.

notFound.no_signature: Nothing to read yet. The payment for this lot has no transaction on the network so far.
notFound.not_finalized: Not final yet. The network has seen the transaction but has not finalized it. Check again in a minute.
notFound.unknown: Not found. The network node reports no finalized transaction with this signature. Open the explorer link or check again later.

state.unreachable: Could not check. Your browser could not read the network just now. This says nothing about the bids.

verify.noSettlement: This lot has no payment yet, so there is nothing to compare. The signatures above are still checked.
verify.howHash: How the proof is built: SHA-256 over each bid's signed text and signature, in order, one per line.
verify.howChain: A memo is a short note attached to a Solana transaction. The payment carries one that reads hp:settle:, the settlement ID, a colon and the proof. Your browser asks the Solana network for the finalized transaction and reads that note itself.

chain.heading: What the network shows
chain.finalized: Finalized, the network's highest confirmation level
chain.memo: Memo text as read from the network
